newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,023 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,023 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,023 contracts compared with 790 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 224 wheat, 276 corn, 402 soybean, 45 soymeal, 52 soyoil, six oat, one corn put, nine soybean calls and eight soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to three cents higher, corn was steady to 1/2 cent lower and soybeans were 1/4 to 1-1/4 cents lower.
